name: a wall clock flips years while the experiment slowly completes
looks: A silhouetted figure works at a bench. A small wall-mounted card above them flips from one year to the next across several hard cuts, 1905, 1906, 1915, 1916, while the apparatus on the bench grows more complete and a thin diagonal ray with a small axis label draws further each time, until the full result sits finished and labelled.
build: The year card is a flipping DOM text swap on each cut, set directly with no easing, same mechanic as live-readout-hud; the apparatus and the diagonal ray's reveal both advance a little further on each cut, cued to the same year change rather than a separate clock, with a small axis label (annotated-diagram-overlay's anchored callout) appearing once the result is legible.
sound: A soft mechanical tick on each year flip, a faint workshop ambience under the figure's work.
prompt: Hold a silhouetted figure working at a bench while a small wall card flips forward through several years across hard cuts, the apparatus growing more complete and a diagonal ray's reveal advancing a little further each time, until a labelled result sits finished, compressing years of work into one continuous, legible build.
